title: Madero and the fall of Díaz
goal: Report what Díaz and Madero said, with reported speech in the past.

items: I can report what someone said, with *dijo que* and the verb shifted back.
I can say what Díaz told a journalist in 1908.
I can explain how Madero's plan led to the revolution and the end of Díaz's rule.
I can use the words *la entrevista*, *la oposición*, *el fraude* and *renunciar*.
